title: Leaving Home
summary: Wang Lin and Wang Ping spend eight years wandering mountains, rivers and seas, and Wang Ping visits Qilian Peak and Sun Tai's tomb, still begging to learn cultivation. They settle in Qishui City on Planet Ran Yun, where Sun family members mock Wang Ping and Sun Hai tries to cripple him, and Wang Lin destroys Sun Hai's Golden Core and silences his elders with Dao intent. Qing Yi, a young Sun family member, warns them to run, and is locked up for siding with outsiders. Sun Qiming, now clan master, comes to the Wang Residence, recognises Wang Lin's aura, and orders the whole clan to keep away from the benefactor their ancestor bows to. Wang Lin offers Wang Ping thirty years of wealth instead of cultivation, but Wang Ping vows to become supreme among mortals by his own effort. Wang Lin asks Qing Yi, now cast out of her clan, to spend sixty years by Wang Ping's side in return for a chance at cultivation, and she accepts.
